caption: The drawing features three fireplace tools displayed vertically against a plain background, each with a graduated scale below for measurement. From left to right, the objects are a pair of tongs, a poker, and a shovel. All three tools have similarly styled handles, which are depicted in a brassy yellow color with decorative turned elements and rounded finials. The tongs on the left have a metallic gray color for the gripping ends and arms, with brass detailing at the joint and handle. The tool in the middle is a poker, also showing a brassy yellow, ornate handle transitioning to a straight, metallic gray shaft. The rightmost object is a shovel, presenting the same brass-toned handle, with the remainder of the tool—a wide, flat scoop and its stem—in a textured gray to suggest a metal surface. The drawing is signed "Hans Korsch" in the lower left corner. The composition is enclosed within a double-lined rectangular border.
title: Fire Tongs and Shovel
